mapper.sql: review_score AS (SELECT product_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) review_score, COUNT(*) review_count FROM review GROUP BY product_id), main_image AS (SELECT product_id, MAX(image_url) image_url FROM product_image WHERE image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' GROUP BY product_id)
mapper.select:
WITH sales AS (SELECT po.product_id, SUM(od.quantity) sales_quantity FROM orders_detail od JOIN product_option po ON po.product_option_id = od.product_option_id WHERE od.delivery_status = '5' GROUP BY po.product_id),
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.sales_quantity DESC, p.product_id) rank, p.product_id, b.brand_name, p.product_name, p.discount_rate, p.price, NVL(rs.review_score, 0) review_score, NVL(rs.review_count, 0) review_count, mi.image_url, s.sales_quantity FROM sales s JOIN product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id JOIN brand b ON b.brand_id = p.brand_id LEFT JOIN review_score rs ON rs.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN main_image mi ON mi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.sales_quantity DESC, p.product_id FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

WITH SELECT p.product_id, b.brand_name, p.product_name, p.price, p.created, p.discount_rate, NVL(rs.review_score, 0) review_score, NVL(rs.review_count, 0) review_count, mi.image_url FROM product p JOIN brand b ON b.brand_id = p.brand_id LEFT JOIN review_score rs ON rs.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN main_image mi ON mi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_name LIKE '[오늘의집 단독]%' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.created DESC
